title: Cupping, IASTM and Myofascial Release — A Claims Audit

hook.en: "Draws out toxins." "Breaks down scar tissue." "Releases tight fascia." These phrases sound scientific and feel convincing in the room. This lesson audits each claim fairly: what is the claim, does the research support it, and what is a respectful, honest way to talk about it, including with patients for whom cupping has cultural meaning.
hook.ur: "Zehreelay maddey nikalta hai." "Scar tissue torta hai." "Tight fascia kholta hai." Yeh alfaaz scientific lagte hain aur kamray mein qaail kar-ne wale lagte hain. Yeh lesson har daawe ka munsifana audit karta hai: daawa kya hai, kya research himayat karti hai, aur izzat aur imaandari se is par baat karne ka tareeqa kya hai, un mareezon ke saath bhi jin ke liye cupping ka saqafati matlab hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll audit the common claims made for cupping, instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilisation (IASTM) and myofascial release (MFR), summarise what trials show, identify safety issues (especially wet cupping), and discuss these treatments respectfully and honestly with patients.
goal.ur: End tak aap cupping, instrument-assisted soft tissue mobilisation (IASTM) aur myofascial release (MFR) ke aam daawon ka audit karenge, trials kya dikhate hain khulasa karenge, safety ke masail (khaaskar wet cupping) pehchanenge, aur in ilajon par mareezon se izzat aur imaandari se baat karenge.

text.en: A **claims audit** asks three questions of each treatment: **What is claimed? What do controlled trials show? What can safely be said?** **Cupping** uses suction cups on the skin (dry cupping) or after small skin cuts (wet cupping, hijama). **IASTM** uses hand-held tools to stroke or scrape the skin and soft tissue. **MFR** uses sustained, gentle manual pressure on fascia. For all three, trials are mostly **small and of low quality**, the effects on pain and movement are **small and short-lived** when seen, and the proposed mechanisms (toxins, adhesions, fascia release) have little direct support.
text.ur: **Claims audit** har ilaaj se teen sawal poochhta hai: **Kya daawa hai? Controlled trials kya dikhate hain? Mehfooz taur par kya kaha ja sakta hai?** **Cupping** jild par suction cups (dry cupping) ya jild par chhote cut ke baad (wet cupping, hijama) istemal karti hai. **IASTM** haath mein pakde aalon se jild aur naram tissue par ragar ya khurchna karta hai. **MFR** fascia par musalsal, narm manual dabao istemal karti hai. Teeno ke liye trials zyada tar **chhote aur kam quality ke** hain, dard aur harkat par asar, jab nazar aaye, **chhote aur mukhtasar** hain, aur tajweez shuda tareeqe (zehreelay maddey, chipkawein, fascia ka khulna) ka seedha saboot kam hai.

text.en: Think of **a house inspector**. They walk through each room and list: what the seller says (claim), what they can actually test (evidence), and what is safe to live with (safety). They do not insult the seller; they just check. An audit is not an attack, it is a careful look.
text.ur: **Ghar ka inspector** sochein. Woh har kamray mein ja kar likhta hai: bechne wala kya kehta hai (daawa), woh asal mein kya jaanch sakta hai (saboot), aur kis ke saath rehna mehfooz hai (safety). Woh bechne wale ki tauheen nahi karta; bas jaanchta hai. Audit hamla nahi, ehtiyat se dekhna hai.

rows.en: "Draws out toxins, lifts fascia, improves blood flow"
rows.ur: "Zehreelay maddey nikalta hai, fascia uthata hai, khoon ka bahao behtar karta hai"

rows.en: Small trials suggest short-term pain relief compared with no treatment; unclear versus sham; no evidence that toxins are removed; round marks are bruises
rows.ur: Chhote trials be-ilaaj ke muqabale mein mukhtasar dard ke aaram ka ishara karte hain; sham ke muqabale mein ghair wazeh; zehreelay maddey nikalne ka koi saboot nahi; gol nishan neelay nishan hain

rows.en: Culturally and religiously important to many; little reliable evidence of benefit; real risks of infection and blood-borne disease if not sterile
rows.ur: Bohat se logon ke liye saqafati aur mazhabi taur par ahem; faide ka kam bharosemand saboot; sterile na ho to infection aur khoon se phailne wali bimariyon ka haqeeqi khatra

rows.en: Small, short gains in range of motion and some pain relief in low-quality trials; no good evidence that tissue is "broken up"; bruising is common
rows.ur: Kam quality ke trials mein range of motion mein chhote, mukhtasar izafay aur kuch dard ka aaram; tissue ke "tootne" ka koi achha saboot nahi; neelay nishan aam
"Tight fascia kholta hai, asal lambai bahal karta hai"

rows.en: Possible small, short-term reductions in chronic pain in some reviews; the gentle pressure used cannot plausibly stretch fascia permanently; effects are more likely neural and contextual
rows.ur: Kuch reviews mein chronic dard mein mumkina chhoti, mukhtasar kami; istemal hone wala narm dabao fascia ko mustaqil taur par nahi kheench sakta; asraat zyada tar neural aur context se mutalliq

question.en: A patient asks, "Does cupping pull toxins out of my body?" What is a respectful and honest answer?
question.ur: Mareez poochhta hai, "Kya cupping mere jism se zehreelay maddey nikalti hai?" Izzat bhara aur imaandar jawab kya hai?

text.en: "There is no evidence that it removes toxins; some people find it relaxing and it may ease pain for a while. If you choose it, let us make sure it is clean and safe."
text.ur: "Zehreelay maddey nikalne ka koi saboot nahi; kuch logon ko yeh sukoon deti hai aur thori der dard kam kar sakti hai. Agar aap chunein to dekhte hain ke saaf aur mehfooz ho."

feedback.en: Yes — respectful, honest about toxins and open about comfort and safety.
feedback.ur: Haan — izzat bhara, zehreelay maddon ke baare mein imaandar aur aaram aur safety ke baare mein khula.

text.en: "Yes, the dark marks show the toxins coming out."
text.ur: "Haan, kale nishan zehreelay maddon ke nikalne ko dikhate hain."

feedback.en: The marks are bruises, not toxins.
feedback.ur: Nishan neelay nishan hain, zehreelay maddey nahi.

text.en: "That is nonsense and nobody should ever do it."
text.ur: "Yeh bakwas hai aur koi kabhi na kare."

feedback.en: It ignores culture and is dismissive.
feedback.ur: Yeh saqafat nazar-andaaz karta hai aur radd karne wala hai.

question.en: Why is wet cupping (hijama) a particular safety concern?
question.ur: Wet cupping (hijama) khaas safety ki fikr kyun hai?

text.en: It involves cutting the skin and drawing blood, so unsterile equipment or technique can spread infection and blood-borne diseases
text.ur: Is mein jild kaat kar khoon nikala jata hai, isliye non-sterile saman ya tareeqa infection aur khoon se phailne wali bimariyan phaila sakta hai

feedback.en: Yes — single-use sterile equipment and trained practitioners are essential.
feedback.ur: Haan — ek baar istemal hone wala sterile saman aur trained practitioners lazmi hain.

feedback.en: Dry cupping is generally low risk if done properly.
feedback.ur: Dry cupping sahi kiye jane par aam taur par kam khatre wali hai.

feedback.en: Cost is not the safety issue.

question.en: A therapist says, "I break down scar tissue with this scraping tool." How can you respond using evidence?
question.ur: Therapist kehta hai, "Main is khurchne wale aale se scar tissue torta hoon." Saboot ke saath aap kaise jawab de sakte hain?

text.en: Ask what the controlled trials show; the evidence is limited and there is no good proof that tissue is broken down, though short-term gains in movement may occur
text.ur: Poochhein controlled trials kya dikhate hain; saboot mehdood hai aur tissue ke tootne ka koi achha saboot nahi, halaanke harkat mein mukhtasar izafay ho sakte hain

feedback.en: Yes — the mechanism claim and the clinical effect are separate questions.
feedback.ur: Haan — tareeqa-e-kaar ka daawa aur clinical asar alag sawal hain.

text.en: Accept it, because the skin turns red
text.ur: Maan lein, kyunke jild surkh ho jati hai

feedback.en: Redness is skin irritation, not proof of benefit.
feedback.ur: Surkhi jild ki jalan hai, faide ka saboot nahi.

text.en: Say that nothing can ever help scars
text.ur: Kahein ke koi cheez scars ki madad nahi kar sakti

feedback.ur: Narm loading aur harkat madad karte hain.

text.en: **Mocking patients' beliefs, or repeating claims you have not checked.** Cupping has deep cultural and religious meaning for many patients in Pakistan, and ridicule ends the conversation and sends people to unsafe providers. Equally, do not repeat "releasing", "toxins" or "breaking down" as if they were facts. Say what is known, respect the person's choice and focus on safety and on what helps most: movement, strength and a clear plan.
text.ur: **Mareezon ke yaqeen ka mazaq udana, ya aise daawe dohrana jo aap ne jaanche nahi.** Pakistan mein bohat se mareezon ke liye cupping ka gehra saqafati aur mazhabi matlab hai, aur mazaq baat cheet band karta aur logon ko ghair mehfooz provider ke paas bhejta hai. Isi tarah "release", "zehreelay maddey" ya "torna" ko haqaiq ki tarah na dohrayein. Jo maloom hai woh batayein, insaan ke intikhab ki izzat karein aur safety aur us par tawajjo dein jo sab se zyada madad karta hai: harkat, taqat aur saaf plan.

text.en: **Ask, listen, then advise.** Start with "What does this treatment mean to you?" and "What have you noticed after it?" Then give the honest summary and focus on safety: clean, trained practitioner, no broken skin, no anticoagulants without advice, and no cupping over areas with infection or skin disease. If you offer dry cupping or MFR, present it as an optional comfort measure beside exercise, and record consent.
text.ur: **Poochhein, suniye, phir mashwara dein.** "Is ilaaj ka aap ke liye kya matlab hai?" aur "Is ke baad aap ne kya mehsoos kiya?" se shuru karein. Phir imaandar khulasa dein aur safety par tawajjo dein: saaf, trained practitioner, toota jild nahi, mashwara ke baghair anticoagulants nahi, aur infection ya jild ki bimari wale hisson par cupping nahi. Agar aap dry cupping ya MFR dete hain to isay exercise ke saath ikhtiyari aaram ke tareeqe ke taur par pesh karein, aur razamandi record karein.

question.en: If these treatments rarely beat sham in trials, why do patients often feel better?
question.ur: Agar yeh ilaaj trials mein shayad hi sham ko haraate hain to mareez aksar behtar kyun mehsoos karte hain?

answer.en: Touch, attention, relaxation, expectation and ritual have real effects on pain, and many painful conditions improve on their own. The combination of hands-on care, a calm room and a story that makes sense can reduce pain and tension for a while. This does not mean the explanation is correct. It does mean that a respectful, caring encounter is worth something, which we can offer honestly without false claims.
answer.ur: Chhoona, tawajjo, sukoon, umeed aur rasam ka dard par haqeeqi asar hota hai, aur bohat si dardnak halatein khud behtar ho jati hain. Hands-on care, pur-sukoon kamray aur aisi kahani ka milap jo samajh aaye thori der ke liye dard aur tanao kam kar sakta hai. Is ka matlab yeh nahi ke wazahat durust hai. Is ka matlab yeh hai ke izzat bhari, dekhbhal wali mulaqat ki qeemat hai, jo hum jhoote daawon ke baghair imaandari se pesh kar sakte hain.

beats.patient: A 50-year-old man with chronic low back pain has been having hijama every few months and asks whether it is safe to continue, as his brother says it "cleans the blood." He takes aspirin daily.
beats.assessment: Hijama has cultural importance, with no good evidence it cleans blood; the main concerns are infection risk and bleeding on aspirin.
beats.treatment: The therapist asks what he notices afterwards, explains kindly that there is no evidence of blood being cleaned and that some people feel relaxed, advises him to use only a trained, clean, single-use-equipment practitioner and to tell his doctor about the aspirin.
beats.reassess: He agrees, adds a walking and strengthening programme and finds his back improves more with the exercise than with the cupping.

text.en: **Skin and bleeding come first.** Avoid cupping and IASTM over broken or infected skin, rashes, varicose veins, recent surgery sites or fractures, in people on anticoagulants or with bleeding disorders, in pregnancy over the abdomen and lower back, and in very frail or thin-skinned patients. Expect bruising and warn patients so they are not alarmed. Never do wet cupping unless trained, licensed and using single-use sterile equipment. Stop at any unexpected pain or skin change.
text.ur: **Pehle jild aur khoon.** Toote ya infected jild, daane, naseen phoolne wali rago, haal ke surgery ke jagahon ya fractures par, anticoagulants lene walon ya khoon ki bimariyon wale logon mein, hamal mein pait aur kamar ke neeche, aur bohat kamzor ya patli jild walon mein cupping aur IASTM se bachein. Neelay nishan ki tawaqqo rakhein aur mareezon ko pehle se batayein taake woh na ghabrayen. Wet cupping kabhi na karein jab tak trained, licensed na hon aur ek baar istemal hone wala sterile saman na ho. Kisi bhi ghair mutawaqqe dard ya jild ki tabdeeli par ruk jayein.

text.en: A systematic review of dry cupping for musculoskeletal pain and range of motion found that cupping may reduce pain compared with no treatment in the short term, but that the trials were small, at high risk of bias and often lacked adequate sham controls, so the certainty of benefit was low. A systematic review of myofascial release for chronic musculoskeletal pain found that it may reduce pain in the short term in some conditions, but the evidence was of low quality, with small samples and heterogeneous methods, and the review could not support strong conclusions about long-term effects.
text.ur: Muskuloskeletal dard aur range of motion ke liye dry cupping ke ek systematic review ne paya ke cupping mukhtasar muddat mein be-ilaaj ke muqabale mein dard kam kar sakti hai, lekin trials chhote, zyada bias ke khatre ke saath thay aur aksar munasib sham controls nahi thay, isliye faide ki yaqeeniyat kam thi. Chronic muskuloskeletal dard ke liye myofascial release ke ek systematic review ne paya ke yeh kuch halaton mein mukhtasar muddat mein dard kam kar sakti hai, lekin saboot kam quality ka tha, chhote samples aur mukhtalif tareeqon ke saath, aur review lambay arse ke asraat ke baare mein mazboot nateeje ki himayat nahi kar saka.

text.en: **Claim, Trial, Safe, Respect.** What is claimed, what trials show, what is safe, and how do we respect the person?
text.ur: **Daawa, Trial, Mehfooz, Izzat.** Kya daawa hai, trials kya dikhate hain, kya mehfooz hai, aur hum insaan ki izzat kaise karte hain?

summary.en: Cupping, IASTM and MFR have small, low-quality evidence for short-term pain relief and little support for claims of toxins, adhesions or fascia release.
summary.ur: Cupping, IASTM aur MFR ka mukhtasar muddat ke dard ke aaram ke liye chhota, kam quality ka saboot hai aur zehreelay maddon, chipkawein ya fascia ke khulne ke daawon ki kam himayat hai.

summary.en: Wet cupping carries infection and blood-borne disease risks unless done sterile by trained people; check skin, medicines and bleeding risk.
summary.ur: Wet cupping mein infection aur khoon se phailne wali bimariyon ka khatra hai jab tak trained log sterile tareeqe se na karein; jild, dawaiyan aur khoon bahne ka khatra dekhein.

summary.en: Discuss these treatments respectfully, say what is known and focus on safety and on movement, strength and a clear plan.
summary.ur: In ilajon par izzat se baat karein, jo maloom hai batayein aur safety aur harkat, taqat aur saaf plan par tawajjo dein.

front.en: What do the round marks after cupping represent?
front.ur: Cupping ke baad gol nishan kya hain?

back.ur: Suction se neelay nishan, zehreelay maddey nahi.

front.en: What is the main extra risk of wet cupping?
front.ur: Wet cupping ka asal izafi khatra kya hai?

back.en: Infection and blood-borne disease if not sterile.
back.ur: Sterile na ho to infection aur khoon se phailne wali bimariyan.

front.en: Can gentle MFR pressure permanently stretch fascia?
front.ur: Kya narm MFR dabao fascia ko mustaqil taur par kheench sakta hai?

back.en: No; the forces used are too small, so effects are more likely neural and contextual.
back.ur: Nahi; istemal hone wali taqat bohat chhoti hai, isliye asraat zyada tar neural aur context se mutalliq hain.

note.ur: Hands-on care ke liye imaandar alfaaz.
